import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check for errors
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --err --lines 3 --nostream")
err = stdout.read().decode()
print("=== Errors ===")
print(err if err.strip() else "NO ERRORS!")
# Test health endpoint
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\\n=== Health Check ===")
print("HTTP Status:", stdout.read().decode())
# Get some logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 logs areloria --lines 10 --nostream")
logs = stdout.read().decode()
print("\\n=== Recent Logs ===")
print(logs[-1000:] if len(logs) > 1000 else logs)
client.close()
'
